text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Grand Live concluded with roaring 
success! The feelings and songs truly 
connected the Umamusume and fans, creating 
a place where everyone could shine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later. Having experienced the Grand Live, 
the Umamusume also threw themselves 
enthusiastically into practicing as 
back-up dancers for the Winning Live.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of the fans cheering for her, 
she wants to dance with a smile no matter 
her position— She seemed to have grown 
tremendously through the live performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Around that time, Light Hello brought over 
a photograph. A picture of the members 
singing with bright smiles was chosen to 
announce next year's Grand Live.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A place where Umamusume and fans can share 
their feelings— "I want to keep the Grand 
Live going for the future," Light Hello 
declared with conviction.
